## About
Next Level Customs is a family owned business. We opened selling wheels at our first location on Miami Blvd. in Durham, then added audio/video, in-house custom interior and minor mechanic work, and later painting. Now we're one of the few places in the Triangle with all of these services in-house.
We work with all kinds of people. Parents who want a back-up camera on their kid's car, and professional athletes customizing every part of their vehicle. Either way, we bring the same attention to detail.
Come see us at 3108-C Glen Royal Rd in Raleigh. Our customers have given us 4.6 stars across 118 Google reviews.

## Services
- Custom Wheels & Tires: New and aftermarket wheels from brands like Vossen, Forgiato, Lexani and Wheel Pros, mounted and balanced by our trained tire technicians.
- Tinting & Vinyl: Window tint for cars and buildings, plus vinyl wraps. We're a direct dealer for Suntek Film.
- Autobody, Paint & Powdercoating: Full paint jobs, caliper paint and decals, and powdercoating for wheels and other parts.
- Audio/Video: Our Audio/Video master technician handles everything from simple installs to custom setups.
- Suspension: Lowering cars and installing lift kits on off-road vehicles. We can get that perfect stance.
- Security & Radar: Security and radar installs for your vehicle.
- Custom Interiors: Custom interiors, reupholstery and interior trim work.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance on collision repairs?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies on collision work.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: We do. Look over our financing options and give us a call with any questions.

Q: Do you carry used tires?
A: Yes. We carry both new and used tires and wheels.

Q: Do you do any mechanical work?
A: We handle minor mechanic work in-house. One reviewer had her radiator and an oil leak fixed on her Jeep Cherokee here.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
